# Context

Live External Integration run 31587452003 (operator-sanctioned dispatch) failed both
live-LLM arms (anthropic + openai) on two pure-configuration causes.

## Cause 1 — region is exported only on the bedrock arm (confirmed mechanism)

`.github/workflows/external-integration.yml` L202-203 (origin/main) guard BOTH region
vars on the arm:

    AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ matrix.provider == 'bedrock' && vars.AWS_BEDROCK_CI_REGION || '' }}
    REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION: ${{ matrix.provider == 'bedrock' && vars.AWS_BEDROCK_CI_REGION || '' }}

On the anthropic and openai arms both evaluate to the empty string. But
`tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:32` pins
`_MODEL = "bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6"` — a bedrock-routed model
*regardless of which arm runs it*. So every 0707 cell on a non-bedrock arm hits
`build_bedrock_provider` with no resolvable region and raises the typed
`LLMConfigError` naming `REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION`. A region is not a credential
(it is a repository *variable*, per the file's own preflight comment), so the
per-arm guard buys no credential isolation here — it only starves arms that run
bedrock-pinned modules.

## Cause 2 — ANTHROPIC_API_KEY repository secret missing

The anthropic arm emits `::error title=anthropic arm has no credential::`. Adding the
secret is an OPERATOR action (repo settings). The arm's fail-not-skip design is CORRECT
and must not be changed.

# Plan

1. `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml` L202-203: drop the
   `matrix.provider == 'bedrock' &&` guard from both region vars and give them a
   literal `us-east-1` fallback, so every arm resolves a region:
   `${{ vars.AWS_BEDROCK_CI_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}`. `us-east-1` is rebar's
   documented Bedrock region (`docs/llm-framework.md:182`,
   `docs/calibration/overlap_batch_confidence.md:10`).
   Update the adjacent comment block (L194-201) to say why the region is now
   unguarded: live-LLM modules may pin a `bedrock:` model on any arm.
2. `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md` §"Bedrock: region is a separate, mandatory setting":
   the text says "The arm sets both …", which becomes stale. One sentence: the region
   is set on EVERY arm because bedrock-pinned modules run on all of them.
3. Comment on this ticket recording the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret as an operator action.

Out of scope: the fail-not-skip credential design; AWS credential (OIDC) availability on
non-bedrock arms — the OIDC step stays guarded on `matrix.provider == 'bedrock'`, so a
bedrock-pinned cell on the anthropic arm may still fail on *credentials*. That is a
distinct defect and gets its own `discovered_from` ticket rather than being folded in
here; this ticket's AC2 is scoped to the region-resolution signature only.

# Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1 — `REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION` (and `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`) are exported for the
  live-LLM suite step on every matrix arm, resolving to `us-east-1` when
  `vars.AWS_BEDROCK_CI_REGION` is unset.
- [x] AC2 — The 0707 banking cells no longer fail on region resolution (evidence: run
  link, or `[operator-attested]` citing run 31587452003's failure signature + the env diff).
- [x] AC3 — A comment records that adding the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` repository secret is an
  operator action, and that the arm's fail-not-skip design is correct and unchanged.
